I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't find anything about Thornbury Cloth Co. that she could also see: nothing in the brain, the shared files or #central-team. There's no account folder, no order form and no deadline on record, so I can't confirm or rule out the 23 May date.

I also told her that no year was given. Today is 14 Oct 2026, so it's either a date that already passed this year or one next May. I'm treating it as an unconfirmed rumour and didn't save it as a fact. I suggested she get the deadline in writing from the customer or ask whoever owns the account, and offered to help track it once it's confirmed.
